title: Murray and Casey step away as Dublin joint managers
desc: Dublin women's footballers are on the hunt for a new management team after Derek Murray and Paul Casey confirmed they will not be seeking a third term at the helm.

title: Seagulls sign 'exciting' Azeez and 'excellent' Andres
desc: Brighton completed deadline moves for Nigeria winger Femi Azeez from Millwall and Spanish defensive midfielder Chema Andres from Stuttgart. Azeez joins in a deal worth £12.5m - potentially rising past £15m with add-ons - while the move for Andres is worth £15.5m. Azeez scored 11 goals and provided eight assists in 37 games last season for Millwall, earning a place in the PFA Championship team of the year.

title: Peacock-like displays outpace antlers and tusks in evolutionary change, model suggests
desc: Many animal species, ranging from peacocks and birds of paradise to some lizards, fish and beetles, display physical features or ornaments that can attract potential mates. These ornaments can include colorful plumage, elaborate tails or fins, inflatable throat sacs and elongated eye stalks.
